name: My Grocery Shop Simulator VR
summary:
Open the doors of your very own grocery store, and get ready for customers.

Grab boxes, open them and stock the shelves with your own hands.
Set the price of every product. Too cheap and you lose money, too expensive and customers walk away.
Scan items at the checkout, take cash or card, and count out the change.
Order new stock, unlock new product licenses, upgrade shelves and fridges.
Hire a cashier and staff who keep the store running while you plan.
Buy new stores, from a corner shop to a hypermarket,
